title: AURA Validation Chain Registry: Public Engineering-Evidence Anchors for Aerostatic Gas-Bearing Rotor Systems
description: The AURA Validation Chain Registry is a public evidence registry for aerostatic and gas-static bearing rotor systems. It contains machine-readable validation entries, public engineering-evidence anchors, residual-level comparison data, lifecycle states, applicability boundaries, and schema documentation used by the AURA Engineering Platform. This initial public release includes two engineering-evidence anchors: VCR_BRESHEV_CONICAL_P05_METHOD_CHAIN_001 and VCR_AURA_JOURNAL_AEROSTATIC_L4_DUAL_BENCHMARK_001. This release is benchmark-scope engineering evidence and is not an arbitrary-geometry production validation claim.
